{{lead.First Name:default=Hello}},
Thank you for registering to become a Flywire partnered agent.
In order to activate your agent portal please complete the following:
- Flywire Due Diligence form <[[https://assets.flywire.com/documents/Flywire-Due-Diligence-Form-for-Entities-Referral-Partners.doc]]> - Confirm your ABN (for Australian companies) or send a copy of your company registration document
Once processed, we will send your agreement with 0.2% commission for Foreign Exchange transactions.
Once we receive your documents, please allow 7-10 business days for us to complete the sign up process. Our Agent Sales team will be in touch once the agreement is ready.
For any questions or support, please contact us at agent.solution@flywire.com <[[mailto:agent.solution@flywire.com]]>.
Best,
The Flywire Team Flywire Global Headquarters 141 Tremont Street, Boston, MA 02111 United States
